priorityReview.title: Targeting F.nucleatum with metronidazole plus tislelizumab and fruquintinib in MSS colorectal cancer: A multicenter phase 2 study.
priorityReview.sourceLevel: PubMed primary abstract verified; full primary source not available for complete clinical verification.
priorityReview.reason: Single-arm phase2 Fn-positive MSS mCRC,33 enrolled; abstract ORR19.4%/DCR83.9% lack explicit evaluable denominator and confidence intervals. CTgov NCT06356597 has no posted results. Full Cell/ScienceDirect/Elsevier responses are unavailable placeholders or403; EuropePMC has no full text/supplement. Do not infer31 evaluable, causal antimicrobial benefit or change practice.

priorityReview.title: Predicting Blood Flow in Reconstructed Intestines Based on Abdominal Aortic Calcification and Clinical Effects of Left Colic Artery Preservation in Colorectal Cancer Surgery: A Subanalysis of the HiSCO-09 Study.
priorityReview.sourceLevel: PubMed primary abstract verified; full primary source not available for complete clinical verification.
priorityReview.reason: HiSCO-09 exploratory subanalysis of282,135 high aortic calcification. LCA-preservation subgroup may be confounded; exact subgroup denominators, adjusted estimates/CI and safety need full text. Wiley403; not established indication for vessel-preservation strategy.

priorityReview.title: Factors associated with chemotherapy free interval (CFI) after induction chemotherapy in metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC) based on a meta-analysis on ARCAD CRC database: The CFI-SCORE project.
priorityReview.sourceLevel: PubMed primary abstract verified; full primary source not available for complete clinical verification.
priorityReview.reason: CFI-SCORE individual-patient meta-analysis1188 across6 historical trials, modest discrimination0.56. Need full eligibility, six source trials/overlap, model specification, missingness, calibration and validation. Not proof that score-guided treatment breaks improve outcomes. Elsevier unavailable/ScienceDirect403.

priorityReview.title: Efficacy and safety of cetuximab or capecitabine monotherapy as maintenance therapy in RAS/BRAF Wild-type metastatic colorectal cancer: a retrospective study.
priorityReview.sourceLevel: PubMed primary abstract verified; full primary source not available for complete clinical verification.
priorityReview.reason: Retrospective maintenance cohort162(cetuximab53/capecitabine27/observation82),not randomized. Need full adjusted HR/CI, time origin, confounding handling and grade-specific safety denominators. Nonsignificant agent comparison is not equivalence. Elsevier unavailable/ScienceDirect403.
